entities.summary: The Archeological Museum of Raqqa, also known as the Raqqa Museum, is a museum in Raqqa, Syria founded in 1981. The structure housing the museum was built in 1861 and served as an Ottoman governmental building. The museum is dedicated to the preservation of the culture of the Raqqa Governorate.
